raw_text: Every year like clockwork around Aug 5 the Pakistani bot armies activate. This year it's particularly bad - I've reported at least 50 accounts in the past hour all posting the same fabricated images with #KashmirBleeds hashtag. Some of these atrocity photos have been debunked multiple times - they're from Syria not Kashmir. The ISPR playbook hasn't changed but the scale has increased massively. Twitter/X needs to do better at catching coordinated campaigns.
clean_text: Pakistani bot armies activated around August 5 anniversary posting fabricated images with Kashmir hashtags. Atrocity photos previously debunked as originating from Syria. Scale of coordinated campaign has increased significantly.
